Conceptual Mapping: Learning Languages (Phases 1–4)



Practices Progression Framework
This framework provides a generic progression of the teaching sequences and shows how the practices increase in complexity across Novice 1, 2 and 3, supporting clear and adaptable progression. It is intended to guide teachers in determining the best entry
point and teaching approach for their students, acknowledging the diversity of language learning journeys and prior experiences.


 Linguistic Knowledge
 Know basic pronunciation, spelling, writing systems, punctuation, vocabulary, signs, and simple sentence structures, including formulaic expressions.


 Cultural and Sociolinguistic Knowledge
 Know that cultural values and norms shape communication, behaviours, and interactions.

Communication Modes Table

Communication
The skills across each communication mode below support effective communication during the Novice phase. The modes are interconnected, and progress in one strengthens progress in others. Teachers design their teaching programmes by selecting and
teaching the communication skills, knowledge, and practices that best meet the needs of their students.
